name: tagcomplete
title: Tag Autocomplete
author: DominikDoom (ported to Diffucore UI)
description: Tag autocompletion for the prompt and negative prompt textareas. Suggests tags from Danbooru/e621/derpibooru CSV files, LoRAs from models/loras/, wildcard files, and chant presets. Includes tag frequency tracking, alias/translation search, keyboard navigation, and wiki links. Configure the tag file, LoRA/wildcard sources, and key bindings in the Settings panel.
